name: Portfolio Blurbs
tagline: Keep every portfolio company's one-paragraph blurb current — founders confirm it monthly, and your snippet library never goes stale.
who: Venture partners and platform teams who keep a description of every portfolio company for emails and intros, and are tired of founders catching a two-month-old blurb.
how: Your agent loads the company list into a live spreadsheet you can edit, writes a short check-in email in your voice, and once a month asks each founder whether their blurb is still right — after you approve the batch. It reads the replies a week later, logs every change with the founder's exact words, and asks you to approve each new blurb before it lands. Confirmed blurbs go into a snippet file, and into Superhuman team snippets when you are signed in. Nothing is sent without your yes.
